scripts.migrate:deploy: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate deploy --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.migrate:status: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate status --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.migrate:resolve: sh -c 'if [ -f ../../.env ]; then set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; fi; prisma migrate resolve --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma'
scripts.studio: sh -c 'set -a; . ../../.env; set +a; port=${PRISMA_STUDIO_PORT:-5555}; url=${PRISMA_STUDIO_URL:-http://localhost:$port}; echo "Prisma Studio URL: $url"; prisma studio --schema ./prisma/schema.prisma --port "$port" --browser none'
